title: Bounded tape window
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $x$ be an input string, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $a\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $n\in\mathbb{N}$. A bounded tape window consists of the following properties: $n>0$; at time $t$ every work-tape head lies in $[a,a+n)$; at that time all work-tape cells outside this interval are blank; every position in the interval was visited by some work-tape head by time $t$; $n\le 2t+1$; and at every time up to $t$, every work-tape head lies in $[a,a+n)$.
